'''Tistura Paan''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] who lived in the [[Baran Do]] [[Baran Do temple|temple]] and trained among the Baran Do sages. She was the apprentice of [[Master of the Order (Baran Do)|Mistress of the Order]] [[Tila Mong]], and at one point dueled [[Ben Skywalker]] in exchange for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son to have council with the mistress.
